package.description: Overlay for running GPU shaders on top of Windows desktop and Wine

en-US.description: Overlay for running GPU shaders on top of Windows desktop and Wine
en-US.name: ShaderGlass
en-US.releaseNotes:
Minor bugfixes and enhancements raised by you, the users! 🙇 And to celebrate ShaderGlass' 5th birthday!
- "Stretch" aspect ratio option
- add Output Scales <100%
- display shader's parameter count in Browser window
- option to keep PC awake
- allow input window override from command line and option to auto-close (see below)
- allow setting output display from command line (see below)
- prevent crash when shader exceeds texture size limits
- fix compilation hang when running multiple instances
- fix saving crop information for device inputs
- fix compatibility with KDE Plasma 6.8
Three new command line options to help people who auto-start ShaderGlass with games/emulators:
- -input "window name" will override input window to one from command line (full window name or just prefix)
- -autoclose will automatically close ShaderGlass when input window gets closed
- -display N will move ShaderGlass to the specified display on startup:
  - 0 - primary display
  - >0 - Nth display from the left/top
  - <0 - Nth display from the right/bottom
These work best if you also supply a .sgp profile on the command line, set up for Window Input.
